outil: image_gen intégré avec références visuelles locales
statut: V3 validée par Boris le 21 octobre 2026 ; transmise à Claude portable pour intégration. Aucun déploiement effectué par Codex.
demande: Se rapprocher des scènes d’Une drôle d’époque et d’Avant le Zéro, avec symboles inspirés du Point Zéro.
direction_artistique: Personnages expressifs, décors contemporains, tessellation en mosaïque, texture minérale et lignes dorées. Symboles PZ intégrés aux éléments du décor.

images.prompt: COMPLETE STYLE REVISION of image 1, an event image whose SUBJECT is retained but whose origami figure rendering must be abandoned. Images 2 and 3 are the actual narrative scenes from the Point Zéro journeys 'Une drôle d’époque' and 'Avant le Zéro' and are the PRIMARY art direction: expressive, approachable contemporary people with believable faces and human emotions, slightly angular drawing, small tessellated mosaic facets across the whole scene, subtle mineral pigment and paper grain, thin warm-gold networks and cracks woven into the environment. Match the illustrated facial expressiveness, modern clothes, dimensional lived-in rooms and restrained atmospheric light of these two references. NOT the huge folded-paper angular masks and sculptural paper dolls of image 1; NOT photorealism, NOT cute cartoon, NOT cozy ochre lifestyle. Deep teal, blue, plum, muted rust and olive with antique gold accents and warm human skin, a balance of shadow and light. Image 4 is a reference for integrating Point Zéro power symbols into the setting; image 5 is the recognizable colored PZ spiral emblem, use its circular swirling form as a meaningful in-scene mosaic/inlay, not a pasted branding sticker. A few large clear narrative elements, readable at thumbnail size. Contemporary event context with neoarchaic visual language. NO title, NO captions, NO lettering, NO watermark. EXACT vertical 3:4 full bleed. These are FOUR distinct event illustrations; create only the single event requested here. EVENT: ATELIER PRESENTIEL. Five expressive adults of varied genders and ages around one round table in a modern simple workshop room. Two are placing large symbolic cards, one speaks with open hands, the others actively listen. The surface of the round table is a detailed but readable mosaic of the PZ spiral emblem, adapted from image 5, muted jewel colors embedded into the material. Around its central Source point lie six modest colored power tokens, each with a simple engraved emblem inspired by image 4, no words. In the background one unobtrusive horizontal golden infinity curve connects two large overlapping circles on a workshop board. Keep focus on mutual attention, faces and gestures; no ceremony, no cloaks. Simple strong composition.
